GC-correct read-count windows for one sample

Source: R/read_counts.R
calculate_OE_ratio.Rd

Estimate per-GC-bin bias factors from the reads that fall inside the retained windows wins_filtered, then compute expected counts and the observed/expected ratio for every retained window.

Usage

calculate_OE_ratio(
  wins_filtered,
  wins_gc,
  reads_list,
  coords_list,
  gc_bins_use = 81:321,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

wins_filtered

Named GRangesList of read-count windows with numeric metadata column raw_counts (e.g. output of filter_windows()). Ranges must be named: windows are matched to wins_gc by names().

wins_gc

Named GRangesList (same chromosome names) with named ranges and metadata columns GC_bin_000 ... GC_bin_400 (bases per GC bin) and row_sum.

reads_list

Named list of numeric read-position vectors, one per chromosome (e.g. count_reads()$reads_list).

coords_list

Named character vector of RDS file paths, one per chromosome; each RDS holds a list of 401 numeric vectors of genome positions per GC bin.

gc_bins_use

Integer indices (1-401) of GC bins used for correction.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with

wins_ratio

wins_filtered with added numeric metadata columns expected_counts and oe_ratio. oe_ratio is NA where row_sum != win_size or the expected count is 0.

gc_factors_per_bin

named numeric vector (length 401) of GC bias factors, NA for GC bins without genome coverage.

Details

Reads are assigned greedily to the 401 GC bins (GC 0.000-0.400 step 0.001 bins as produced by the tigeR genome processing), visiting the GC bins with the most retained positions first. The bias factor of a GC bin is (reads fraction) / (genome fraction). The expected count of a window is sum_{gc in gc_bins_use} bases_in_gc_bin * factor * median(raw_counts) / win_size / 2, where win_size is the median of row_sum in wins_gc.
